Sandbox_RBP_Enabled_tooltip: Disabling this leaves book script values unchanged after the next restart.
Sandbox_RBP_MinimumPages_tooltip: Used when a range omits its lower bound. All resolved page counts are clamped to the global limits.
Sandbox_RBP_MaximumPages_tooltip: Used when a range omits its upper bound. All resolved page counts are clamped to the global limits.
Sandbox_RBP_FallbackPages_tooltip: Five values ordered Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced / Expert / Master. Each value can be fixed (120) or a per-spawn range (>80<240, >80, or <240).
Sandbox_RBP_AdjustWeight_tooltip: When enabled, qualifying skill-book weight is calculated from its resolved page count.
Sandbox_RBP_ReferencePages_tooltip: A book with this many pages uses the reference weight.
Sandbox_RBP_ReferenceWeight_tooltip: Weight assigned to a book at the reference page count.
Sandbox_RBP_BindingWeight_tooltip: Fixed portion of book weight. Values above the reference weight are safely capped at the reference weight.
Sandbox_RBP_VaryOrdinaryBooks_tooltip: Give spawned subject hardcovers and paperbacks individual page counts. Magazines, newspapers, notebooks, recipe literature, and skill books use their own rules.
Sandbox_RBP_ScaleMoodEffectsByWeight: Scale literature mood effects by weight
Sandbox_RBP_ScaleMoodEffectsByWeight_too: Scale boredom, stress, and unhappiness changes by spawned weight divided by the item's original weight. The multiplier is uncapped, keeping the total effect proportional to book size.
Sandbox_RBP_ApplyMoodEffectsWhileReading: Grant each varied book, magazine, recipe magazine, or newspaper's scaled mood effects at reading-progress milestones instead of granting the full effect at completion.
Sandbox_RBP_MoodEffectStepPercent_toolti: Percentage of the book that must be newly completed before the next portion of boredom, stress, and unhappiness relief is granted. Use 10 for ten milestones or 5 for twenty.
Sandbox_RBP_OrdinaryBookPages_tooltip: Fixed pages or a per-spawn range such as >80<550, >80, or <550. Weight is calculated from the resulting page count.
Sandbox_RBP_VaryMagazines_tooltip: Give qualifying miscellaneous magazines individual page counts. Only non-writable magazines whose original script weight is exactly 0.5 qualify.
Sandbox_RBP_MagazinePages_tooltip: Fixed pages or a per-spawn range such as >16<72. Weight is calculated from the resulting page count.
Sandbox_RBP_VaryRecipeMagazines_tooltip: Calculate recipe-magazine pages from a base amount plus pages for every taught recipe. Correctly tagged expansion-mod recipe magazines are supported.
Sandbox_RBP_RecipeMagazineBasePages_tool: Pages for cover matter and general content before taught recipes are counted. Accepts a fixed value or range such as >10<20.
Sandbox_RBP_RecipeMagazinePagesPerRecipe: Pages added for each recipe taught by the magazine. Accepts a fixed value or range; the final total is clamped to the global page limits.
Sandbox_RBP_VaryNewspapers_tooltip: Give tagged newspapers individual page counts while preserving their original content-generation callbacks.
Sandbox_RBP_NewspaperPages_tooltip: Fixed pages or a per-spawn range such as >16<48. Weight is calculated from the resulting page count.
